transforms.name: hostRunFromSummary
transforms.effect: Copies profileId and profileSet. It never sets account, so a VibeField row cannot carry the field.

transforms.name: deriveAgentRow
transforms.effect: Copies host.account onto the row only when the host set it. Here the host did not.

transforms.name: monitorHostRun
transforms.effect: Separate Puppeteer Godview host, not VibeField: account is the profile label when profileId is set.

transforms.name: accountUsageView
transforms.effect: accountUsage profile labels feed the usage column. They are not written to field.account.

transforms.name: createMonitorBackend
transforms.effect: fieldd hosts the monitor backend on the runtime source and passes the current-epoch cost reading.

transforms.name: wireMonitorRow
transforms.effect: The model wire drops device.self. This desktop's window otherwise reads the row whole.

transforms.name: peerMonitorRow
transforms.effect: A peer loses project.seq and has detail, activity line, wait text, and reply text bounded.

transforms.name: modelRowFrom
transforms.effect: The reader restores device.self and fills a missing writable from attachable.

transforms.name: window-rows
transforms.effect: No display rewrite for this field. The row is spread through, aside from peer stale and peer profileSet.

defaults.when: this adapter's traced producers do not supply the row field

applicability.notes: Views listed are confirmed readers in the five shipping monitor views.

verification.notes: Account trace audit/godview/contracts/account-trace.md at 08b5d849177685662b43e0e3a4e6bd7d32ac2cdf. No adapter emits field.account. derive.ts:273 copies host.account only. Under the VibeField host, hostRunFromSummary (agent-monitor.ts:223-266) copies profileId and profileSet and never account, so the field is unreachable and always absent. The Puppeteer Godview host is separate: monitorHostRun (apps/godview/src/main/monitor-host.ts:62,79) sets account from the profile label when profileId is set. This adapter has a profiles service (providers.ts:307). Its accountUsage service (createGrokAccountUsageService at providers.ts:671) feeds the usage column (views/src/usage/account-usage.ts:63-82), not field.account. List still reads agent.account at AgentList.tsx:151 and :185, but a VibeField row never fills it. Audit pin is puppeteer 748d015, newer than the 0.3.3 package vibefield ships (tag v0.3.3, commit 52d09c8e). This record does not compare 0.3.3 behavior. A transform effect ending in [post-0.3.3] cites a puppeteer file whose text differs from 52d09c8e.
